notes.title: Anniversary patch! ✨
notes.notes:
Hey there! 💪



We've been working these months fixing a few bugs that you have reported us along the way. This is the changelog for further information:



version 2025.08.11-01 

moved path on the right a little bit more to the left (for better legibility) 

added hard limit on wraith fungus count to avoid huge fps bombs 

fixed a dialogue trigger. Now if you come to Omen by right side instead of left side it also triggers the entrance dialogue 

prevented crash on empty save file 

fixed returning taken/hidden items only adds a single copy back, instead of all the ones you had

fixed possible crash when mashing keys in inventory

fixed death to red company missions failed instead of complete 

attempted to patch around move action crapping out with destroyed entities

fixed shelf mushrooms, since they could kill you at 1hp, causing different issues

fixed possible crash with inventory ui (eg shelf mushroom) 

fixed trading murzo for infinite profit in iyo act

made mortar boss dying early trigger final phase 

fixed some labels in options overflowing with long text 

updated batteries, which reduces garbage generation from physics 

fixed name from ohtil -> ohtli 

fixed wrong order pause ui save slot time 

reworked waiting for the teleport particles

return debug_pick for devs



Thanks again for your support ✨

notes.title: More bugfixes, more save slots and in-game lyrics!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your reviews! We've reached Overwhelmingly Positive which I officially puts us in the cool kids gang and will grant us entry to gamedev valhalla. 🫡

We're still working on localisation and expecting to deliver it soon™. Meanwhile we're pushing this patch with smaller changes and lots of bugcrash fixes.

Switch has also received a patch recently and we'll keep updating it to make sure it's quality matches the steam version.


Patch Summary

 Reworked save menu and allowed more save slots
 Added subtitles to in-game songs.
 Fixed a lot of crashes.


Changelog

 New load/save menu with 5 manual and 10 auto saves, and fixed some graphics bugs there
 Added song subtitles
 Couple patches to player combat inventory, so killed characters drop ALL their items and also so it doesn't get duplicated if you win the combat and get back
 Added camera pan scaler so that people who are motion sick can turn it off
 Adjusted Itzae skill tree so the passive upgrades are visible right away
 Restored character HP in starting bar silently when they are re-added 
 Now coins show correctly if you have 99+ coins
 Added healing loot before bog ambush so players don't get instakilled
 Made it so you don't have to have Atzi to dig up previously discovered gold and some other Atzi interactions
 Added flags to avoid accidentally skipping Holyground interaction
 Fixed various description inconsitencies and typos
 Patch so teleport works as dash on Mountain Temple
 Reworked Lamb logic so Zoka and Lamb are different events and trigger independently
 Ending Guilt threshold adjustement

 Nerfed Brace slightly.
 Nerfed mushroom spread mushrooms slightly

 Fixed goat mission and password box
 Fixed (some) infinite money exploits
 Fixed El Gallo fight not triggering animations
 Fixed line drawing cache potentially growing forever
 Fixed skeleton talking even if you killed him
 Fixed bug with fires in RC_HQ 
 Fixed ending achievement
 Fixed clifftops watchtower crash
 Fixed El Gallo fight animations and ending explosions killing player
 Fixed crash in revive corpse action
 Fixed inv lost reference crash
 Fixed minecarts and fuel tanks so they can't be exploded with Explode Corpse
 Fixed quick_shot_dash action crash
 Fixed one of the temple combats not self-completing

 Added SetProcessDPIAware for Windows to hopefully avoid blurriness on high DPI screens
 Added high DPI window flag for Mac (separately handled on Windows)

notes.title: Bugfixes, Demo, Assist Mode, and What's Next
notes.notes:
First of all thank you everyone for enjoying Arco, and reporting all the bugs!

If you played Arco but haven't left a reivew yet, please do, it helps 💕

Patch summary

 Lots of crash and bug fixes. Let us know if you find anything we missed.
 Demo! Some people asked so we brought the free demo back! It's important to notice that the demo is the first 2-3 hours of the game and that the saves carry over to the final, if you choose to buy, so it is the best way to see if you like the game!
 Assist mode in settings for players who care about the story but are struggling with combat. You can use it to blow stuff up, skip combat and turn off ghosts. We recommend experiencing the game without it, but we want to make sure everyone can get the most fun out of the game. 
 Option to skip Act I when replaying the game. To make Obelisk hunting and looking for alternate paths a more pleasant process.
 Holding space previews bullet paths. Thanks for the suggestion.


What's next

 Localisation. Arco will be translated into 6 languages:
- Spanish - LATAM
- German
- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Portuguese - BR
The translations are planned to release before end of the month on Steam.
 Switch patches. We realise Switch version of the game runs worse than PC and has additional bugs. There's a Patch on the way addressing the main issues. As we can't instantly push new changes to Switch, the fixes there will lag behind the ones here. Hope you understand. We hope that the upcoming Switch patch will be accepted by Nintendo in the following week.
 More and more fixes. Hopefully, most of the issues are now resolved, but we'll keep an eye out for more bug reports and tackle them asap. 


Changelog
- Fixed 2x Mana Buff sometimes not working in combat
- Assist Mode
- Added Act 1 skip when replaying the game.
- Fixed some Achievements not triggering.
- Changed scenario summary presentation a little
- Patched accidentally leaving Zoka behind
- Typo fixes
- Increased draw scale for the pre-fight UI in encounter for comfortable reading on Switch/Deck
- Fixed use button visible for one frame if it shouldn't be on opening inventory
- Fixed crash in boss_moth
- Rattler mission hints
- Fixed lizard egg softlock 
- Patched items that do damage when consumed so they don't break the game if used in pre-battle
- Fixed Chali trader shop crash
- Fixed wrong-size overlay with funny res
- Less blinding crash screen
- Reworked Sprite Caching
- Fixed infinite money loop (one of em at least)
- Bunch of skill description fixes
- Fixed Revive Corpse crash
- Added missing 'worm ghost' description
- Fixed being able to take Zoka past the forest
- Fixed train wormhole
- Fixed archeology minigame crash
- Added missing mana pickup description
- Fixed kid ball mission not finishing
- Added bullet paths visible when holding space

First person to find another crash on Steam and ask gets a key for their friend >:)
